stages.caption: Check the empty balance before loading. A fixed zero offset can remain even when repeated loaded readings have little spread.
Place the same sealed specimen on the pan. Do not record a moving or unsettled indication.
Record reading 1 in grams. Subtract the recorded empty indication to obtain the zero-corrected value.
Calculate the mean and range. Optional s/√n describes repeatability of the mean under independent-reading assumptions;it is not total uncertainty or proof of accuracy.
